choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 看你这模样，是遇到麻烦了？

say:0:1410405001:0.text: A miracle! Her Majesty's grace shines upon me! Please come with me.
say:0:1410405001:0.source_cn: 女王在上！奇迹降临了！请随我来。

say:2:1410406001:0.text: Davin, it looks like you've been through quite an ordeal...
say:2:1410406001:0.source_cn: 达温，看你的样子，似乎经历了不少艰辛……

say:3:1410406002:0.text: Thanks to the Queen's blessing, I have finally completed my mistress' task. Lady Shelvy, I wish to trade some Divine Dew for two sets of clothing.
say:3:1410406002:0.source_cn: 承蒙女王庇佑，我终于完成了女主人的任务。舍尔菲大人，我...

say:4:1410406003:0.text: Are you certain? You don't have much left, do you?
say:4:1410406003:0.source_cn: 用恩典灵露？你确定吗？你的时间恐怕不多了吧……

say:5:1410406004:0.text: No need to worry. This success will please my mistress. Tomorrow, I'll receive a fresh supply of dew.
say:5:1410406004:0.source_cn: 请不必担心。这次的成果应该能让女主人喜悦，明天我就能拿...

say:6:1410406005:0.text: I see... Very well. Take them. Bring me half of the Divine Dew tomorrow, and that will suffice.
say:6:1410406005:0.source_cn: 我明白了，拿去吧。明天带来一半的灵露就足够了。

say:8:1410406006:0.text: Thank you for your kindness. May the Queen's blessing be upon you.
say:8:1410406006:0.source_cn: 感谢您的慷慨……愿女王庇佑您。

say:9:1410406007:0.text: Kind sir, please accept this as your reward.
say:9:1410406007:0.source_cn: 这位好心的大人，请接受这份报酬吧。女王将见证我们的交易……
say:9:1410406007:0.male: Kind sir, please accept this as your reward.
say:9:1410406007:0.female: Kind madam, please accept this as your reward.

say:10:1410406008:0.text: Whoever you may be, may the Queen's mercy light your path.
say:10:1410406008:0.source_cn: 无论您是谁，愿女王的仁慈永远照拂于您。
say:10:1410406008:0.male: Whoever you may be, may the Queen's mercy light your path.
say:10:1410406008:0.female: Whoever you may be, may the Queen's mercy light your path.

say:12:1410406009:0.text: The people here hold a deep reverence for the Queen... but beneath that devotion, something seems hidden.
say:12:1410406009:0.source_cn: 看得出这里的人们对女王怀着深深的敬畏，但这份敬畏中……...
say:12:1410406009:0.male: The people here hold a deep reverence for the Queen... but beneath that devotion, something seems hidden.
say:12:1410406009:0.female: The people here hold a deep reverence for the Queen... but beneath that devotion, something seems hidden.

say:13:1410406010:0.text: Divine Dew, dwarven secrets, the Essail, and a corruption known for its horrendous transformation... Could Hogan's disappearance be tied to all of this?
say:13:1410406010:0.source_cn: 恩典灵露，矮人与艾塞勒一族的秘密，还有名为孽化的变异…...

say:1:1410407002:0.female: There seems to be some commotion over at the plaza...

say:1:1410409001:1.text: Merciful Queen, guide Aven through this trial...
say:1:1410409001:1.source_cn: 仁慈的女王，请指引阿瓦度过这艰难的时刻……

choice_prompt:2:1410409001.text: Merciful Queen, guide Aven through this trial...
choice_prompt:2:1410409001.source_cn: 仁慈的女王，请指引阿瓦度过这艰难的时刻……

say:3:1410409002:1.female: Poor Aven... He tripped and spilled some Divine Dew. You must have heard his screams.

say:4:1410409003:1.text: By the Queen's mercy, I pray his master, Lord Andeno, won't mark him with the Stigma of Judgment.

choice_prompt:5:1410409003.text: By the Queen's mercy, I pray his master, Lord Andeno, won't mark him with the Stigma of Judgment.

say:6:1410409004:1.text: You speak as if you've never seen one! Have you never erred before? Or is your master so forgiving? You must live a charmed life...
say:6:1410409004:1.source_cn: 年轻的艾塞勒，你竟如此天真！你是从未犯过错？还是遇到了...

say:7:1410409005:1.source_cn: 听着，被刻下惩罚印记意味着无法领取恩典灵露甚至驱逐。

say:7:1410409005:1.female: Listen well—being marked with the Stigma means losing the right to the Divine Dew... or worse, exile.

say:8:1410409006:1.text: And exile is a death sentence. The corruption will take you, and the suffering will never end. I-I shouldn't say more...
say:8:1410409006:1.source_cn: 一旦被驱逐，等我们的只有孽化这一个结局！那将是无尽的痛...
say:8:1410409006:1.male: And exile is a death sentence. The corruption will take you, and the suffering will never end. I-I shouldn't say more...
say:8:1410409006:1.female: And exile is a death sentence. The corruption will take you, and the suffering will never end. I-I shouldn't say more...

say:9:1410409007:1.text: You should count yourself lucky. Now, go. Finish your master's errand.
say:9:1410409007:1.source_cn: 珍惜你仁慈的主人！快去完成主人的任务吧。

say:15:1410409011:1.female: The place is filthy, diseased, and crawling with dwarves and other wretched things...

say:19:1410409013:1.source_cn: 女王在上！你疯了吗？那也太可怕了！
say:19:1410409013:1.male: By the Queen! You must be mad to ask such things! That's unthinkable!
say:19:1410409013:1.female: By the Queen! You must be mad to ask such things! That's unthinkable!

say:20:1410409014:1.text: Whatever you're planning, forget it. Getting involved with toplanders is a curse upon the soul.
say:20:1410409014:1.source_cn: 我不管你想干什么，与地表人扯上关系一定很危险……
say:20:1410409014:1.male: Whatever you're planning, forget it. Getting involved with toplanders is a curse upon the soul.
say:20:1410409014:1.female: Whatever you're planning, forget it. Getting involved with toplanders is a curse upon the soul.

say:21:1410409015:1.text: Oh, you poor misguided wretch... May the Queen's light shield you from the taint of the surface...
say:21:1410409015:1.source_cn: 哦，可怜的年轻人！愿女王的荣光指引着你免受地表的污染……
say:21:1410409015:1.male: Oh, you poor misguided wretch... May the Queen's light shield you from the taint of the surface...
say:21:1410409015:1.female: Oh, you poor misguided wretch... May the Queen's light shield you from the taint of the surface...

choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 你见过矮人之外的地表人吗？

choice:13:0:1.text: What happened to the last one?
choice:13:0:1.male: What happened to the last one?
choice:13:0:1.female: What happened to the last one?

say:0:1410410001:0.text: No word of Hogan. The people's fear is unnatural. I need more answers.
say:0:1410410001:0.source_cn: 霍根的下落还是没有打听到，而他们的态度也很奇怪……只能...
say:0:1410410001:0.male: No word of Hogan. The people's fear is unnatural. I need more answers.
say:0:1410410001:0.female: No word of Hogan. The people's fear is unnatural. I need more answers.

say:1:1410412001:0.text: Filthy wretch, how dare you meet my gaze?
say:1:1410412001:0.source_cn: 肮脏的仆从，竟敢直视我的眼睛！
say:1:1410412001:0.male: Filthy wretch, how dare you meet my gaze?
say:1:1410412001:0.female: Filthy wretch, how dare you meet my gaze?

say:2:1410412002:0.text: Who gave you leave to wander? Who do you serve?
say:2:1410412002:0.source_cn: 谁允许你在这里游荡？你的主人是谁？
say:2:1410412002:0.male: Who gave you leave to wander? Who do you serve?
say:2:1410412002:0.female: Who gave you leave to wander? Who do you serve?

choice_prompt:3:1410412002.text: Who gave you leave to wander? Who do you serve?
choice_prompt:3:1410412002.source_cn: 谁允许你在这里游荡？你的主人是谁？
choice_prompt:3:1410412002.male: Who gave you leave to wander? Who do you serve?
choice_prompt:3:1410412002.female: Who gave you leave to wander? Who do you serve?

say:4:1410412003:0.source_cn: 哼，原来是无主的仆从啊……

say:5:1410412005:0.text: Still... you carry yourself unlike the rest of these dogs. So—
say:5:1410412005:0.source_cn: 不过……你的举止可不像个普通的仆从啊。那么——

say:5:1410412005:0.female: Still... you carry yourself unlike the rest of these dogs. So—

say:6:1410412006:0.text: Fetch me a dram of Divine Dew. And if you fail...
say:6:1410412006:0.source_cn: 你，去给我取一份恩典灵露来！如果你做不到……
say:6:1410412006:0.male: Fetch me a dram of Divine Dew. And if you fail...
say:6:1410412006:0.female: Fetch me a dram of Divine Dew. And if you fail...

say:7:1410412007:0.text: I'll brand you with the Stigma of Judgment myself. But if you succeed...

say:7:1410412007:0.female: I'll brand you with the Stigma of Judgment myself. But if you succeed...

say:11:1410412010:0.text: Your clumsiness bores me, Aven. It's time for a new toy.

choice_prompt:12:1410412010.source_cn: 我已经厌烦你的笨拙了，是时候换个新玩具了。

say:13:1410412011:0.source_cn: 快去，别浪费我宝贵的时间！

say:15:1410412012:0.text: How dare you speak to me like that?! Guards, seize him!
say:15:1410412012:0.source_cn: 你竟敢如此对我说话！卫队，给我抓住<male>他</m...
say:15:1410412012:0.male: How dare you speak to me like that?! Guards, seize him!
say:15:1410412012:0.female: How dare you speak to me like that?! Guards, seize her!

choice:12:1:2.text: I don't have time to waste.
choice:12:1:2.male: I don't have time to waste.
choice:12:1:2.female: I don't have time to waste.

choice:11:1:2.female: Are you really surprised by this?

say:4:1410458301:0.source_cn: 你们整天说这是恩典，可我们不过是渴望活下去……

say:5:1410458302:0.text: Caiden and Bethwyn wasted away before our eyes. You watched them wither, yet you wouldn't spare even a drop of dew!
say:5:1410458302:0.source_cn: 凯登和贝丝薇的生命已经消逝了，你们眼睁睁地看着他们孽化...

say:6:1410458303:0.text: And what of the nobles? They hoard ten times what we receive. Why?!
say:6:1410458303:0.source_cn: 然而贵族们呢？一人能分到我们十倍的量！凭什么？

say:7:1410458304:1.text: We're the ones keeping Sal'thorin standing! We serve, we toil, and yet we are left to starve!
say:7:1410458304:1.source_cn: 维持萨洛克兰，伺候他们的都是我们！

say:9:1410458305:0.text: My sister was so proud, so happy to be chosen for the royal city... Not long after, news of her death came.
say:9:1410458305:0.source_cn: 我的姐姐满心欢喜地被选入了王城……没过多久，就传来了她...

say:10:1410458306:1.text: All because she spilled a glass of wine! Just an ordinary glass of wine, not even the precious Divine Dew!
say:10:1410458306:1.source_cn: 就因为打翻了酒水，只是一杯普通的酒酿，甚至不是宝贵的恩...

say:11:1410458307:1.source_cn: 那个时候，你们又在哪里！

say:12:1410458308:0.text: You're tools for their rule! Look at us!
say:12:1410458308:0.source_cn: 你们不过是维系着贵族们统治的工具！看看我们吧——

say:13:1410458309:1.text: Look at your own people! We are suffering, and now you raise your swords against us?

say:23:1410458314:1.female: Everyone, stand down! Do you want the entire commoners' district to lose access to the Divine Dew?

say:17:1410460014:0.source_cn: 啊，不过那是以后的事了。现在还是工作时间……

say:17:1410460014:0.female: Ah, but that's for another time. Right now, there's work to be done.

say:18:1410460015:0.text: Go find Indris. He's at the <style="highlight">Lunaris Altar</style>. There are far more pressing matters awaiting you.
say:18:1410460015:0.male: Go find Indris. He's at the <style="highlight">Lunaris Altar</style>. There are far more pressing matters awaiting you.
say:18:1410460015:0.female: Go find Indris. He's at the <style="highlight">Lunaris Altar</style>. There are far more pressing matters awaiting you.

choice:9:3:4.text: ... Is this truly the best way?
choice:9:3:4.source_cn: ……这种秩序，真的是最好的选择吗
choice:9:3:4.male: ... Is this truly the best way?
choice:9:3:4.female: ... Is this truly the best way?

say:2:1410418001:0.text: High Priestess! A suspicious commoner has likely disguised themselves as a lowborn and infiltrated the royal city!
say:2:1410418001:0.source_cn: 冕下，我要举报！有个可疑的平民疑似装扮成仆从混入王城！
say:2:1410418001:0.male: High Priestess! A suspicious commoner has likely disguised themselves as a lowborn and infiltrated the royal city!
say:2:1410418001:0.female: High Priestess! A suspicious commoner has likely disguised themselves as a lowborn and infiltrated the royal city!

say:3:1410418002:1.text: I'm certain that wretch is plotting against our sacred Queen!
say:3:1410418002:1.source_cn: 那家伙肯定是想危害伟大的女王！
say:3:1410418002:1.male: I'm certain that wretch is plotting against our sacred Queen!
say:3:1410418002:1.female: I'm certain that wretch is plotting against our sacred Queen!

say:4:1410418003:1.text: A threat to the Queen? Bring forth the accused.
say:4:1410418003:1.source_cn: 对女王不利？将嫌疑者带上来。
say:4:1410418003:1.male: A threat to the Queen? Bring forth the accused.
say:4:1410418003:1.female: A threat to the Queen? Bring forth the accused.

choice_prompt:5:1410418003.text: A threat to the Queen? Bring forth the accused.
choice_prompt:5:1410418003.source_cn: 对女王不利？将嫌疑者带上来。
choice_prompt:5:1410418003.male: A threat to the Queen? Bring forth the accused.
choice_prompt:5:1410418003.female: A threat to the Queen? Bring forth the accused.

say:6:1410418004:0.text: Speak! Who is your master? Who brought you here?
say:6:1410418004:0.source_cn: 那你是谁家的仆从，谁带你来的！说啊？
say:6:1410418004:0.male: Speak! Who is your master? Who brought you here?
say:6:1410418004:0.female: Speak! Who is your master? Who brought you here?

say:7:1410418005:1.text: Hmph! I saw through you from the start. You're definitely a commoner trying to pass as one of us!
say:7:1410418005:1.source_cn: 哼，我早就看穿了！你绝对是混进来的平民！
say:7:1410418005:1.male: Hmph! I saw through you from the start. You're definitely a commoner trying to pass as one of us!
say:7:1410418005:1.female: Hmph! I saw through you from the start. You're definitely a commoner trying to pass as one of us!

say:8:1410418008:1.text: You overestimate the threat of a single commoner, Lord Andeno.
say:8:1410418008:1.source_cn: 安心，一个微不足道的平民，还伤害不了我们全能的女王。
say:8:1410418008:1.male: You overestimate the threat of a single commoner, Lord Andeno.
say:8:1410418008:1.female: You overestimate the threat of a single commoner, Lord Andeno.

say:9:1410418009:1.text: With loyal soldiers at my side, Captain Indris at the helm, and the Queen's will guiding us... what danger could such an insignificant soul possibly pose?
say:9:1410418009:1.source_cn: 在场有忠诚的卫兵、卫队长，甚至还有我，又有什么好担心的呢？

say:10:1410418010:1.text: ... You are right, of course. I trust you will pass fair judgment upon this transgressor.
say:10:1410418010:1.source_cn: ……您说得对！您一定能秉公处理这可恶的平民！
say:10:1410418010:1.male: ... You are right, of course. I trust you will pass fair judgment upon this transgressor.
say:10:1410418010:1.female: ... You are right, of course. I trust you will pass fair judgment upon this transgressor.

choice_prompt:11:1410418010.text: ... You are right, of course. I trust you will pass fair judgment upon this transgressor.
choice_prompt:11:1410418010.source_cn: ……您说得对！您一定能秉公处理这可恶的平民！
choice_prompt:11:1410418010.male: ... You are right, of course. I trust you will pass fair judgment upon this transgressor.
choice_prompt:11:1410418010.female: ... You are right, of course. I trust you will pass fair judgment upon this transgressor.

say:12:1410418011:1.source_cn: 不过，平民，你触犯了律法，必须施于应有的惩罚。

say:13:1410418012:1.text: Captain Indris, you have always upheld justice. What punishment does our law prescribe?
say:13:1410418012:1.source_cn: 就像因度厄卫队长一样，这是公平的明证。
say:13:1410418012:1.male: Captain Indris, you have always upheld justice. What punishment does our law prescribe?
say:13:1410418012:1.female: Captain Indris, you have always upheld justice. What punishment does our law prescribe?

say:16:1410418013:0.text: The standard sentence for a commoner trespassing on restricted grounds is seven days under the Stigma of Judgment.
say:16:1410418013:0.source_cn: 我对惩罚毫无怨言。但冕下，根据律法，平民擅入处罚是七日...

say:17:1410418014:1.text: Seven days... You are merciful as ever, Captain. Very well. Let it be so.
say:17:1410418014:1.source_cn: 因度厄，你对平民还是如此宽宥……就依你所言吧，遵守律法。

say:18:1410418015:1.text: But you understand, do you not, Indris? Punishment is not cruelty—it is discipline. A lesson, not a condemnation.
say:18:1410418015:1.source_cn: 我相信，即使在接受惩罚后……你还是能履行好自己的责任，对吗？

say:19:1410418016:0.text: I do, High Priestess. I do not resent the law, nor do I forsake my duty.
say:19:1410418016:0.source_cn: 奎茵冕下，我永远不会因为惩罚而心怀怨恨，更不会玷污自己...

say:20:1410418017:0.text: Then, all is as it should be.
say:20:1410418017:0.source_cn: 你明白便好。这次的惩戒只是为了让你吸取教训，更加忠诚。

say:21:1410418018:0.text: Captain Indris, you are young, but your dedication is admirable. The Queen recognizes loyalty when she sees it.
say:21:1410418018:0.source_cn: 因度厄，你是位有才能的年轻人。女王总会予以特殊的宽容。

say:22:1410418019:1.text: And let all here remember—the Queen's mercy is boundless.
say:22:1410418019:1.source_cn: 在场者请记住，女王的慈悲远超你们的想象。

say:23:1410418020:1.text: Though Indris bears the Stigma, his station remains. For even in punishment, the Queen's hand uplifts the worthy.
say:23:1410418020:1.source_cn: 因度厄卫队长的惩罚印记只是无法领取灵露，但他的职务将予...

say:24:1410418021:1.text: The Queen loves her people as a mother loves her child. Discipline guides, mercy nurtures, and together, they shape a brighter future.
say:24:1410418021:1.source_cn: 女王如母亲般爱护萨洛克兰的子民——她的惩罚是为了让我们...

cinematic_dialogue:28:1410419001:.text: May her radiance light your path.
cinematic_dialogue:28:1410419001:.male: May her radiance light your path.
cinematic_dialogue:28:1410419001:.female: May her radiance light your path.

narration:30:140104113:0.text: Velara marks you with the Stigma of Judgment. The guards come over, ready to throw you out of the royal city.
narration:30:140104113:0.source_cn: 奎茵施法为你烙上了惩罚印记，卫兵们随后上前来要把你驱逐...
narration:30:140104113:0.male: Velara marks you with the Stigma of Judgment. The guards come over, ready to throw you out of the royal city.
narration:30:140104113:0.female: Velara marks you with the Stigma of Judgment. The guards come over, ready to throw you out of the royal city.

choice:5:0:1.text: Look, if you just let me explain.
choice:5:0:1.male: Look, if you just let me explain.
choice:5:0:1.female: Look, if you just let me explain.

say:31:1410418006:1.text: Hah! Silence is an admission of guilt! You've committed a grave offense!
say:31:1410418006:1.source_cn: 不说话就是承认了！你犯了大罪！
say:31:1410418006:1.male: Hah! Silence is an admission of guilt! You've committed a grave offense!
say:31:1410418006:1.female: Hah! Silence is an admission of guilt! You've committed a grave offense!

say:32:1410418007:1.text: High Priestess, this commoner dares to defy us. Surely, that alone warrants harsher punishment!
say:32:1410418007:1.source_cn: 奎茵冕下，这平民试图违抗，应当罪加一等！
say:32:1410418007:1.male: High Priestess, this commoner dares to defy us. Surely, that alone warrants harsher punishment!
say:32:1410418007:1.female: High Priestess, this commoner dares to defy us. Surely, that alone warrants harsher punishment!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410408002:.text: How dare you squander the Queen's grace!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1410408002:.source_cn: 竟然浪费了女王的恩典！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410416001:.text: Useless fools! You let him slip away!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1410416001:.source_cn: 没用的废物，竟然放走了<male>他</male><female>她</female>！
cinematic_dialogue:1:1410416001:.male: Useless fools! You let him slip away!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1410416001:.female: Useless fools! You let her slip away!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410416002:.text: What are you standing around for? Give chase!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410424001:.text: Caiden... I don't want to become one of them!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410424002:.text: Please, while I'm still myself... end it now.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1410424002:.source_cn: 求求你，趁现在杀了我吧！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410424004:.text: Tomorrow, I will get the Divine Dew!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1410424004:.source_cn: 明天！我一定能拿到恩典灵露！

cinematic_dialogue:2:1410434001:.text: Marked sinner! Get out of here!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1410434001:.source_cn: 有印记的罪人！快滚出来！

cinematic_dialogue:2:1410434003:.source_cn: 贝丝薇快不行了……求你们

cinematic_dialogue:2:1410434004:.text: This is the price of breaking the law!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1410434004:.source_cn: 这就是触犯律法的代价！

say:5:1410435001:0.text: Glory to the Queen! Captain, this commoner with the Stigma tried to sneak into the line, but I caught him!
say:5:1410435001:0.source_cn: 女王荣光永存！报告卫队长！这名带印记的平民妄图混入队伍...

say:8:1410435002:1.text: It's not for me... it's for Bethwyn! She's too weak...
say:8:1410435002:1.source_cn: 我不是为了自己，是贝丝薇。贝丝薇太虚弱了。她快要……

say:9:1410435003:1.source_cn: 求求你们了，各位卫兵大人们！给贝丝薇一点怜悯吧！

say:10:1410435004:0.text: If she wants Divine Dew, she can come get it herself. The law forbids collecting it for others.
say:10:1410435004:0.source_cn: 让她自己来取，律法有言，不得代领！

say:11:1410435005:1.text: She... she can't. She has the Stigma too, she—

say:12:1410435006:0.text: Hmph! Then there's nothing more to say! Do you think the priests punish the innocent or the guilty?
say:12:1410435006:0.source_cn: 哼！那还有什么好说的！祭司大人们难道会平白无故地惩罚无...

say:14:1410435007:0.source_cn: 给她一点慈悲吧，卫兵大人！

say:15:1410435008:1.text: Vexa... Thank you, but I already know how this ends...
say:15:1410435008:1.source_cn: 维克莎，多谢你。我已经知道该怎么做了……

say:16:1410435009:0.text: That's right, commoner. Better to give up now.
say:16:1410435009:0.source_cn: 没错，平民。早点死心为好。

say:17:1410435010:0.text: Oh, and by the way, report her location later. We'll handle the cleanup.
say:17:1410435010:0.source_cn: 对了，待会记得上报她的位置，我们会负责清理。

say:18:1410435011:0.text: No! Bethwyn's still herself! She can hold on. I have to go... She needs me!
say:18:1410435011:0.source_cn: 不，贝丝薇还好。她还能坚持……我先走了！她现在很需要我！

say:23:1410435013:0.text: It's getting late. You can end your shift now.
say:23:1410435013:0.source_cn: 你，时候不早了，准备交接吧。

say:24:1410435014:0.text: Captain, shouldn't we keep an eye on that kid? Just in case...
say:24:1410435014:0.source_cn: 卫队长，我们真的不用去盯着那小子吗？以防万一……

say:25:1410435015:0.text: ...I'll take care of it. Go rest.
say:25:1410435015:0.source_cn: ……无事，我稍后再安排。你早点回去休息。

say:26:1410435016:0.text: Yes, sir! Glory to the Queen!

say:28:1410435017:0.text: Everyone, form a proper line! No pushing. You will all get your share.
say:28:1410435017:0.source_cn: 都排好队，一个一个来领取！

say:31:1410435018:0.text: It's Indris! Everyone, let's line up properly.
say:31:1410435018:0.source_cn: 是因度厄！大家该排队的好好排队……

cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436001:.text: That person in line... they're marked too.
cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436001:.source_cn: 那个排队的人……好像也有印记
cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436001:.male: That person in line... they're marked too.
cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436001:.female: That person in line... they're marked too.

cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436002:.text: Order must be maintained! Step forward one at a time!
cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436002:.source_cn: 保持秩序！大家都能分到

cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436003:.text: Indris... what kind of person are you?
cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436003:.source_cn: 因度厄，你到底是什么样的人？
cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436003:.male: Indris... what kind of person are you?
cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436003:.female: Indris... what kind of person are you?

cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436004:.text: ...Perhaps I should try to get some too.
cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436004:.male: ...Perhaps I should try to get some too.
cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436004:.female: ...Perhaps I should try to get some too.

narration:36:1410437001:0.text: You step into line with the other commoners to receive the Divine Dew. Indris, despite clearly seeing the Stigma of Judgment upon you, chooses to ignore it. Without resistance, the dew is placed in your hands.
narration:36:1410437001:0.source_cn: 你跟随着其他平民排队领取恩典灵露，因度厄似乎对你不加掩...

narration:37:1410437002:0.text: You examine the Divine Dew, sensing the faint magic within. Although the magic is weak, with enough time, it really can keep the corruption at bay.
narration:37:1410437002:0.source_cn: 你探查这份灵露，发现其中蕴含了特殊的魔力……虽然含量很...

narration:38:1410437003:0.text: As you observe the line, you notice something—other marked commoners are receiving the dew as well. Indris, watching over the process, seems to be allowing this.
narration:38:1410437003:0.source_cn: 随后你仔细观察着队伍，同样有一些身负惩罚印记的平民获取...

say:44:1410439001:0.text: Don't hurt him! He's not like the others!
say:44:1410439001:0.source_cn: 不要伤害凯登！他是个好孩子！

say:45:1410439002:0.text: Stay where you are! He's already transformed! If you get too close—
say:45:1410439002:0.source_cn: 别过来！他已经孽化了！为了你们的安全——

say:46:1410439003:1.text: This is your fault! First Bethwyn, now Caiden!
say:46:1410439003:1.source_cn: 都是你们的错！是你们害的！先是贝丝薇，又是凯登！

say:47:1410439004:1.text: You're holding a weapon. Are you planning to cut him down like the others?!
say:47:1410439004:1.source_cn: 你拿着武器，要做什么？是不是要斩下他们的头颅！

say:51:1410439006:1.text: We've given everything to Sal'thorin! Our blood, our lives... only to be cast aside the moment we stumble!
say:51:1410439006:1.source_cn: 我们为萨洛克兰付出了很多！不……我们付出了一切！然而这...

say:52:1410439007:0.text: Ceron's right! The nobles hoard knowledge and resources. We fight and struggle, hoping to climb higher, only to be crushed for the slightest mistake!
say:52:1410439007:0.source_cn: 索伦说的没错！知识和资源被贵族们垄断，我们拼尽全力爬到...

say:53:1410439008:0.text: Generation after generation, we live in fear of corruption, trapped in a cycle we can never break! Is this our destiny?
say:53:1410439008:0.source_cn: 世世代代重复着所谓的命运，时时刻刻面临着孽化产生的风险...

say:54:1410439009:0.text: I understand your pain. I was one of you once... I know how it feels.
say:54:1410439009:0.source_cn: 诸位，我了解你们的痛苦。我也同样是平民出身……

say:55:1410439010:0.text: But right now, we have to stop the spread of corruption. Please, step aside!
say:55:1410439010:0.source_cn: 但现在最重要的是阻止孽化蔓延，请让开！

say:56:1410439011:0.text: Enough! How long are we supposed to endure this?!
say:56:1410439011:0.source_cn: 我受够了！我们凭什么要承受这些？

say:58:1410439012:1.text: Caiden's fate today is ours tomorrow! Don't let them take him! We won't let these so-called guards execute another one of our own!
say:58:1410439012:1.source_cn: 凯登的今日就是我们的明天！拦住他们，不能再让这些刽子手...

narration:60:14010433:0.text: While you're lining up for Divine Dew, Caiden sneaks into the queue again. But before long, he starts to turn, causing panic.
narration:60:14010433:0.source_cn: 你在排队领取灵露时，凯登再次混入了队伍。但他在此过程中...
narration:60:14010433:0.male: While you're lining up for Divine Dew, Caiden sneaks into the queue again. But before long, he starts to turn, causing panic.
narration:60:14010433:0.female: While you're lining up for Divine Dew, Caiden sneaks into the queue again. But before long, he starts to turn, causing panic.

narration:61:14010432:0.text: A commoner, bearing the Stigma of Judgment, seeks to blend into the line. Indris offers no reaction. Intrigued by his indifference, you take your place in the queue, waiting to see his response.
narration:61:14010432:0.source_cn: 身有惩罚印记的平民尝试排在队伍中，但因度厄毫无反应。于...
narration:61:14010432:0.male: A commoner, bearing the Stigma of Judgment, seeks to blend into the line. Indris offers no reaction. Intrigued by his indifference, you take your place in the queue, waiting to see his response.
narration:61:14010432:0.female: A commoner, bearing the Stigma of Judgment, seeks to blend into the line. Indris offers no reaction. Intrigued by his indifference, you take your place in the queue, waiting to see his response.

narration:62:14010431:0.text: The crowd gathers, eager for a taste of Divine Dew. At the back of the line, Caiden stands, a quiet figure among them. As the guards advance to remove him, Indris appears.
narration:62:14010431:0.source_cn: 众人排队领取恩典灵露，而队尾的凯登被发现了。卫兵们驱逐...
narration:62:14010431:0.male: The crowd gathers, eager for a taste of Divine Dew. At the back of the line, Caiden stands, a quiet figure among them. As the guards advance to remove him, Indris appears.
narration:62:14010431:0.female: The crowd gathers, eager for a taste of Divine Dew. At the back of the line, Caiden stands, a quiet figure among them. As the guards advance to remove him, Indris appears.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410445001:.text: With fire's wrath, the mark shall break,

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410445002:.text: And from its ashes, freedom wakes.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410458202:.text: I don't want to transform... Just a sip! I beg you!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1410458202:.source_cn: 我不想孽化，让我喝一口就好！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410458201:.text: My child can't hold on much longer... Please...
cinematic_dialogue:1:1410458201:.source_cn: 我的孩子快撑不住了，求求你们……

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410458203:.text: Arrest me! Let them go free!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410458204:.text: We stand united! They can't stop us now!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1410458204:.source_cn: 看吧，我们团结起来他们也拦不住！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410458205:.text: Shouldn't the Queen's grace be more fair?!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1410458205:.source_cn: 女王的恩典不应该更公平吗？

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410458206:.text: How dare you desecrate the Divine Dew?!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410458207:.text: Everyone, halt! Hand over the Divine Dew immediately!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1410458207:.source_cn: 全都站住！交出恩典灵露！

subtitle:1:1411084002:.text: has marred the sanctity of the Queen's divine rule.

subtitle:1:1411084003:.text: Those who fail in their duties
